name: Exiting the White Room
source:
An owl, a goat, and a wolf live in a white room. They’ve been stuck there for a long, long time. One day, the owl wakes up with a fleeting recollection of the day prior. You, the owl, tries to recall what happened.
[From [url=https://djthunderheart.itch.io/exiting-the-white-room]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一只猫头鹰、一只山羊与一匹狼同住在一间纯白的房间里。它们已经被困在那里很久、很久了。某一天，猫头鹰醒来时，脑海中浮现出关于前一天转瞬即逝的零星记忆。身为猫头鹰的你，正试图回想起究竟发生了什么。
[摘自[url=https://djthunderheart.itch.io/exiting-the-white-room]itch.io[/url]]
